source.name: customers_source
source.query:
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  email,
  registration_date,
  country,
  city,
  age,
  customer_segment,
  total_orders,
  total_spent,
  last_order_date,
  is_active
FROM public.customers 
WHERE is_active = true
AND registration_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')

source.name: orders_source
source.query:
SELECT 
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  order_date,
  order_amount,
  product_category,
  payment_method,
  order_status,
  shipping_country,
  discount_amount,
  tax_amount
FROM public.orders 
WHERE order_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')
AND order_status = 'completed'

tasks.description: Verifica qualidade dos dados de clientes
Verifica qualidade dos dados de pedidos
Cria resumo dos clientes (usando dados originais)
tasks.sql_transform:
SELECT 
  c.customer_id,
  c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name,
  c.email,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.country,
  c.city,
  c.age,
  c.registration_date,
  COALESCE(COUNT(o.order_id), 0) as orders_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0) as total_spent_today,
  COALESCE(AVG(o.order_amount), 0) as avg_order_value,
  CURRENT_DATE as processing_date,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as processed_at
FROM extrair_customers c
LEFT JOIN extrair_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 
  c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email,
  c.customer_segment, c.country, c.city, c.age, c.registration_date

tasks.description: Valida e limpa os dados transformados
tasks.python_transform:
def validate_and_clean(datasets, **context):
    import pandas as pd
    
    data = pd.DataFrame(datasets['transformar_customer_summary_v2'])
    
    if data.empty:
        return []
    
    # Remover duplicatas
    data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['customer_id'])
    
    # Validar email
    data = data[data['email'].notna()]
    data = data[data['email'].str.contains('@', na=False)]
    
    # Limpar valores monetários
    data['total_spent_today'] = data['total_spent_today'].fillna(0)
    data['avg_order_value'] = data['avg_order_value'].fillna(0)
    
    # Validar ranges
    data = data[data['total_spent_today'] >= 0]
    data = data[data['total_spent_today'] <= 50000]
    
    return data.to_dict('records')

tasks.custom_function:
def notify_success(**context):
    import logging
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    dag_id = context['dag'].dag_id
    execution_date = context['execution_date']
    
    logger.info(f"Pipeline {dag_id} executado com sucesso em {execution_date}")
    
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "dag_id": dag_id,
        "execution_date": execution_date.isoformat(),
        "message": "Pipeline concluído com sucesso"
    }
